# FLX-3635: the registry and the contract give the SQL check an unusable table or column

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The check needs each expose of the bundle with its columns and their SQL types. A logical type DuckDB cannot hold (a decimal of more than 38 digits), two exposes of one name, two columns that differ only in case (DuckDB cannot tell them apart), a name in the registry's columns that stands for two columns or is also the name of another column, or a registry that names an expose or a column the schema lacks, is refused.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3635
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
